liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (3 reviews): China Cat Sunflower into I Know You Rider closed the first set well; China Cat Sunflower into I Know You Rider to close the first set is smoking [36][42][45]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Truckin', Smokestack Lightnin', and High Time formed a rare triple threat opening sequence [36]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Scarlet Begonias into Fire On The Mountain is described as brimming with intensity [35]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): Mickey's introduction to Fire On The Mountain is highlighted as amazing [38]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Looks Like Rain is called lovely, with a jam transitioning from whisper to scream [35]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-03-28.dts.griesman.89043.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 155 min [1]
- **gd1985-03-28.mtx.fix-shnid-77465.griesman.89074.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 147 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [2]
- **gd1985-03-28.141047.sbd.acetboy.flac1644**: soundboard; 20 songs; 148 min [5]. Said about its sound: Recording level overloaded during Drums, and Bob's guitar amp produced nasty sounds [5]
- **gd1985-03-38.163428.akg451.neumann.u87.blend.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 19 songs; 148 min [6]
- **gd85-03-28.sbd.griesman.5313.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 142 min; rated 4.25/5 by 28 [10]. Said about its sound: Jerry's voice is noted as a little scratchy during the performance; The sound quality is described as not that great for this recording [42][43]
- **gd85-03-28.oade-schoeps.sacks.23443.sbeok.flacf**: source not stated; 19 songs; 147 min; rated 3.86/5 by 7 [22]. Said about its sound: Jerry's voice is described as toast, indicating significant vocal strain or damage [46]
- **gd85-03-28.sbd-set1.fink.357.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 8 songs; 49 min; rated 4.17/5 by 6 [33]. Said about its sound: This recording is noted as sounding cleaner than others [44]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: Other One [1]
- Matt Kelly sat in on harmonica, and many fans were stuck in the parking lot [38]
- Jerry had bronchitis, and Bobby forgot some lyrics during the show [43]
- During Sugar Magnolia, Bob missed a verse, and the audience sang it for him [46]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-03-28.dts.griesman.89043.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Randy Griesman; source: SBD (5313) + AUD (23443) [1]
- **gd1985-03-28.mtx.fix-shnid-77465.griesman.89074.flac16**: source: See info file [2]. Also: This seed fixes a serious problem with track d1t04 from the 2005 circulation [2]
- **gd1985-03-28.141047.sbd.acetboy.flac1644**: transferred by Pitch correction by acetboy; source: Soundboard> 1st Gen Tape>Nak Dragon>Korg Mr-1000>Audio Gate>Cool Edit>Traders Little Helper>xACT>ProTools LE>xACT; this is a fix for source ID 118304 ; see… [5]. Also: Channels were 180 degrees out of phase, and speed/pitch was slow/flat before fixing [5]
- **gd1985-03-38.163428.akg451.neumann.u87.blend.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Rob Eaton; transferred by Rob, Eaton, Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Rob Eaton's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; (2) AKG 451's w/ CK8 shotguns (Left + Right) + (1)Neumann U87 (Center) blend > Nakamichi 550 [6]. Also: Rob Eaton recorded and transferred the show, using Oade's Schoeps CMC4 MK41 source [6]
- **gd85-03-28.sbd.griesman.5313.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> MC> DAT> CDR [10]
- **gd85-03-28.oade-schoeps.sacks.23443.sbeok.flacf**: taped by Oade Brothers; transferred by Doug Oade - Darren Sacks; source: Schoeps CMC441s (90deg, 17cm) > Oade M118 > Oade mod SONY PCM-F1 [22]
- **gd85-03-28.sbd-set1.fink.357.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD PCM > DAT > Sonic Solutions > CD [33]

claims.text: Scarlet Begonias into Fire On The Mountain is described as brimming with intensity
Looks Like Rain is called lovely, with a jam transitioning from whisper to scream
Truckin', Smokestack Lightnin', and High Time formed a rare triple threat opening sequence
China Cat Sunflower into I Know You Rider closed the first set well
Matt Kelly sat in on harmonica, and many fans were stuck in the parking lot
Mickey's introduction to Fire On The Mountain is highlighted as amazing
Jerry's voice is noted as a little scratchy during the performance
China Cat Sunflower into I Know You Rider to close the first set is smoking
The sound quality is described as not that great for this recording
Jerry had bronchitis, and Bobby forgot some lyrics during the show
This recording is noted as sounding cleaner than others
China Cat Sunflower into I Know You Rider is possibly one of the best ever
During Sugar Magnolia, Bob missed a verse, and the audience sang it for him
Jerry's voice is described as toast, indicating significant vocal strain or damage
This seed fixes a serious problem with track d1t04 from the 2005 circulation
Recording level overloaded during Drums, and Bob's guitar amp produced nasty sounds
Channels were 180 degrees out of phase, and speed/pitch was slow/flat before fixing
Rob Eaton recorded and transferred the show, using Oade's Schoeps CMC4 MK41 source
